plaintext_contract_reconciliation.previous_behavior_contract: Existing PlaintextEnvelope remains the canonical unencrypted auth-key handshake envelope owner. It emits auth_key_id=0:i64, message_id:i64, message_data_length:i32 and 4-byte-aligned handshake message data. The shipping TcpTransport::exchange_plaintext path now adds fixed-U-equivalent 0..63 random 32-bit padding words and includes them in message_data_length. Envelope decode fails closed on non-zero auth_key_id, zero/negative/misaligned or oversized lengths, truncation and declared/actual length mismatch before handshake body parsing; server message-id semantic validation remains in MessageIdGuard.
previous_failure_cases: Empty or non-4-byte-aligned outbound handshake body accepted
Padding above 252 bytes or not divisible by four accepted
Zero/negative/non-4-byte-aligned or oversized inbound length accepted
Envelope work is expanded into connection scheduling, binding/persistence, arbitrary request history, gzip or full difference decoding
